# Antara

> Antara is an AI wellbeing companion for iOS and Android. She remembers you across four modules (Talk, Reflect, Heal, Elevate), can talk face to face with a live digital face, and keeps a plain-words memory you can read and delete. Antara is an AI, not a clinician or a crisis service.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://www.antara.icu/): what Antara is and how it works
- [How it works](https://www.antara.icu/product/): the Antara loop and how the modules share one memory
- [Pricing](https://www.antara.icu/pricing/): seven days free, then Antara+ via App Store or Google Play
- [Privacy](https://www.antara.icu/privacy/)
- [Support](https://www.antara.icu/support/)

## Facts
- Apps: App Store (id6755032385) and Google Play (com.antara.health)
- Made by Antara Innovations
- Not a medical service. In an emergency, contact local emergency services.
